def register(self, pkg):
    lf = open(self._lock, "w")
    try:
        flock(lf, LOCK_EX)
        self._write_index(pkg)
    finally:
        flock(lf, LOCK_UN)
        lf.close()


def unregister(self, pkg):
    lf = open(self._lock, "w")
    try:
        flock(lf, LOCK_EX)
        self._remove_index(pkg)
    finally:
        flock(lf, LOCK_UN)
        lf.close()


def snapshot(self):
    lf = open(self._lock, "r")
    try:
        flock(lf, LOCK_EX)
        return dict(self._index)
    finally:
        flock(lf, LOCK_UN)
        lf.close()
